summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Stephen Bann, a British art historian. It gives his birth date and place, his current academic title as Emeritus Professor of History of Art at the University of Bristol, and his education at Winchester College and King's College, Cambridge, where he earned a PhD in 1967.
one_line: Stephen Bann is a British art historian, Emeritus Professor of History of Art at the University of Bristol.
key_facts: Stephen Bann was born on 1 August 1942 in Manchester, England.
Stephen Bann holds the post-nominal titles CBE and FBA.
Stephen Bann is the Emeritus Professor of History of Art at the University of Bristol.
Stephen Bann attended King's College, Cambridge.
Stephen Bann attained his PhD in 1967.
